components.description: A selected team with right-aligned score and win chance.
components.css: .ds-team-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto auto; align-items:center; gap:24px; width:100%; min-height:100px; padding:10px 24px; border:1px solid #00d49b; border-radius:12px; background:#15382c; color:#f5faf7; font:600 31px "Kalshi Sans",sans-serif; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; } .ds-team-row strong { text-align:right; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-team-row:focus-visible { outline:4px solid #ffda66; outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview: A single broadcast scoreboard ties a football play to two win chances and one illustrative payout.
